goal: Defeat Team Rocket in Silph Co.

subgoals.goal_text: Travel from Cerulean City to Saffron City.
Enter the Silph Co. building in Saffron City.
Fight through the first floor of Silph Co. to reach the elevator.
Use the elevator to navigate through the building, defeating Team Rocket members on each floor.
Locate and defeat Giovanni on the 11th floor of Silph Co.
